(i) that the circumstances from which the conclusion of guilt is drawn are fully established,
(ii) that the circumstances shall be of a conclusive nature and tendency, D.S.R.No.1 of 2019 &

that is to say, they should not be explainable on any other hypothesis except that the accused is guilty,
(iv) that they should exclude every possible hypothesis except that the accused is guilty, and (v) that there must be a chain of evidence so complete as not to leave any reasonable ground for the conclusion consistent with the innocence of the accused and must show that in all human probability, the act must have been done by the accused.
